recognized_test_commands.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('internal/release/check.go')
s=p.read_text()
a=s.index('\\tfor _, identifier := range []string{\"dev\", \"snapshot\", \"rc\"} {')
b=s.index('\\n\\treturn true',a)
s=s[:a]+'''\\tcore, _, _ := strings.Cut(version, \"+\")
	if start := strings.IndexByte(core, '-'); start >= 0 {
		for _, identifier := range strings.FieldsFunc(core[start+1:], func(r rune) bool { return r == '.' || r == '-' }) {
			switch identifier {
			case \"dev\", \"snapshot\", \"rc\":
				return false
			}
		}
	}'''+s[b:]
p.write_text(s)
p=Path('internal/release/check_test.go')
s=p.read_text().replace('{\"v1.2.3\", true}, {\"1.2.3\", true},','{\"v1.2.3\", true}, {\"1.2.3\", true}, {\"1.2.3+build-rc\", true},')
p.write_text(s)

gofmt -w internal/release/check.go internal/release/check_test.go
GOPROXY=off go test ./internal/release ./cmd/flipt ./internal/info ./internal/telemetry ./internal/server/metadata"

limitations: Shell/script/code-mode edits and tests may not be recognized. A failed invocation can be an environment error. Red/green does not prove the right assertion or test-first. Absence of recognized evidence is not noncompliance. Inspect full events and checkpoint.
